title: Terrain workshop — Warthog flight recorder
goal: Reproduce the repeated Warthog wheel jolts. Press F8 when they occur (the preceding five seconds are included), then F8 again to end capture. Physics-rate logs record suspension, contacts, fixed-position ground probes, velocity and streaming brakes. Handling is unchanged. The recorder remains bounded in RAM outside marked captures; marked intervals are written to the session trace.
changes: The map backdrop opening now follows the full workshop bounds (768m from centre), not the original small arena. Height and fallback imagery lookups agree across the ring's zero point. Nearby map geometry has 128m spacing, without refining the entire ring. Gaps between detailed chunks now use 36 cached, coarse SDF scenery tiles from the same authored recipe; the map no longer hides the arena. Detailed chunks replace that scenery and provide collision. Initial loading includes these tiles; later launches reuse disk caches. Small tunnels still need detailed chunks. This does not make the distant DEM landscape playable or increase its source resolution.
controls:
Mountain infill: arm button, then one terrain click. Configure radius, height, seed, noise, wavelength, octaves, erosion strengths/iterations and wind heading. To revise: select mountain, adjust, Apply.
Trees: Paint fir trees, hold LMB; main radius controls size. Density, height, slope and seed have labelled settings. Erase removes overlapping painted patches. Save explicitly. Undo restores edits. 600 resident painted-tree cap.
Raise/Lower: hold LMB. RMB + WASD fly; Space/Ctrl rise/fall. Wheel zoom; Shift-wheel size. F1 play/edit with readiness progress. B in play throws grenades. F8 log markers; F3 chunks; F2 briefing.
